constanta_south_centre_about.title: About the Centre

callout.text: You cannot walk here from the South Gate — it's 7.5 km away and walking inside the terminal is forbidden. Take the free shuttle (see below).

constanta_south_centre_about.note: Run by Apostleship of the Sea / Stella Maris, and doubles as the ITF Seafarers' Centre. Closed Orthodox Easter, 1 January, 25 December.

constanta_south_centre_services.title: Services

groups.label: Legal
items: ITF office on site — legal help for union members

constanta_south_centre_services.note: The free shuttle to and from your ship is the centre's key service here — without it there's no practical way to reach it from the South Port.

constanta_south_centre_shuttle.title: Free Shuttle Bus
constanta_south_centre_shuttle.from: Right at your gangway, on call

directions.title: Book 1–2 hours ahead
directions.sub: Through your agent, or WhatsApp the club directly

directions.title: How to recognise it
directions.sub: White minivan (Ford Transit / VW Crafter) with a Stella Maris / ITF Seafarers' Trust logo on the windscreen

constanta_south_centre_shuttle.note: Free of charge. Booking is not optional here — this is the only realistic way in or out for South Port arrivals, since walking inside the terminal is against ISPS rules.

constanta_south_centre_location.title: Location & Route

callout.text: NOT RECOMMENDED — walking inside the terminal is strictly forbidden under ISPS security rules. Use the agent's transport or the club shuttle only.

contacts.title: Incinta Port Constanța, Gara Fluvială, Clădirea Seamen's Club, Constanța 900900
contacts.sub: ~7.5 km from the South Gate (Poarta 10) — closer to the North Port side (Poarta 1)

constanta_south_centre_location.note: Even if you could walk it, avoid it: the route crosses the huge DP World container terminal, heavy truck traffic, no pavements, and stray dogs. Take the shuttle.

callout.text: Yes — shore leave is normally permitted. Always confirm with your Master or agent first.

constanta_south_transport_taxi.title: Taxi

rows.title: Outside Poarta 10 checkpoint
rows.sub: City taxis can't drive into the terminal without a special pass

constanta_south_transport_taxi.note: ~40–60 RON (~€8–12) into the city. Unofficial drivers: white or yellow cars with no company markings or roof sign, hanging around Poarta 10, pushing their services. Always insist on the meter (Aparat de taxat) or book through Bolt — don't agree to a fixed price a private driver names.

constanta_south_transport_public.title: Public Transport

rows.title: "Poarta 10"
rows.sub: ~150 m from the checkpoint exit

rows.title: Bus 153 (to Agigea / Lazu)
rows.sub: Transfer to bus 2-43 for Constanța city centre

constanta_south_transport_public.note: 45–60 minutes total. ~3 RON per ride, contactless bank card on the validator or the 24PAY app. Last bus around 22:30–23:00.

callout.text: Only the Romanian leu (RON) is legal tender. Euros are usually not accepted in shops or taxis, or only at a very poor rate — exchange some cash or use a card.

rows.title: A stranger offers you a better rate
rows.sub: On the street, at the gate, or "just around the corner" — always a scam

rows.title: Being asked to go somewhere private
rows.sub: A car, a back room, an alley — a legitimate exchange never needs this

rows.title: No receipt offered
rows.sub: A real exchange always gives you a printed receipt with the rate used

rows.title: Know the rough official rate first
rows.sub: Check on your phone before you go — so you can spot a bad deal immediately

rows.title: Count what you receive, before you walk away
rows.sub: In front of the person who gave it to you, not after
